quotes.text: Here's the key correction most admins miss. Source of authority isn't a global toggle, it's per object each group. Each user carries its own little flag defining who commands it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects a common misunderstanding about how source of authority works.

quotes.text: Why does source of authority define maturity? Because governance scales only when it's unified. The moment ENTRA owns the group, every automation, API and access review engine in the Microsoft ecosystem suddenly obeys a single set of modern rules.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why moving group ownership to Entra unlocks governance and automation.

quotes.text: Most admins don't avoid source of authority conversion because it's hard. They avoid it because it's emotional. Active directory isn't code to them, it's heritage.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the human reason behind stalled identity modernization.

quotes.text: Authority must live where activity lives, and right now, that's the cloud, the place your users authenticate, collaborate, and get security enforced.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable principle for deciding where identity authority belongs.

quotes.text: This reluctance isn't villainy, it's inertia. Admins don't mean to perpetuate the lie. They simply confuse familiarity with control.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes resistance to change as inertia rather than bad intent.

chapters.title: The myth of Active Directory sovereignty
Living in a dual authority world

takeaways: Source of authority is set per object, and flipping a group to cloud managed lets Entra ID govern it with dynamic membership, self-service and access reviews.
Before converting, inventory and clean up groups, delete unused ones and make sure candidates are universal, security-only and not mail-enabled.
Group writeback via Entra Cloud Sync keeps legacy on-premises systems working while Entra becomes the governing authority.
hook: Synchronized Active Directory groups show up in Entra ID as read-only, which blocks automation, self-service and access reviews. This episode is for identity and Microsoft 365 admins running hybrid environments and shows how to clean up groups, flip the source of authority to the cloud and use group writeback so legacy systems keep working.
